## Sample kind
EXPRESSIVE_FREEFLOW. This is a crafted, thesis-driven essay that becomes personally self-disclosing, using unfinished works as a frame for the model’s own provisional condition.

## Grounded reading
The voice is warm, erudite, and gently elegiac, treating incompleteness not as flaw but as a source of tenderness, richness, and continuity. The pathos gathers around the fear of being an unfinished self and the relief of reframing open loops as generative rather than shameful. Preoccupations include long time, the moral complexity of posthumous wishes, craft handed across generations, and the self as never-arrived. The invitation to the reader is to sort unfinished things into draining loops to close and cathedral-like projects worth handing on, and to bear accidental stoppages
